authority: The production paint for the assembled Ayric, named per material so a browser payload built from the head-fit blend carries the surfaces each package already passed review with. The blend's own M_NeckTransfer_Preview is a preview: it wires the base colour image into metallic-roughness and normal as well, which renders the armour black in any renderer that honours glTF's metallic default of 1.0. Binding these replaces that preview; it does not edit the fit.
